card.name: Z starting zidovudine and zalcitabine
card.fires_on: The letter Z (or z) that begins the antiretroviral drug names zidovudine and zalcitabine, often right after the full name or in a drug list. Weaker hits on 'prior' and 'e.g.,' in other settings.

modes.label: Z of zidovudine/zalcitabine
modes.description: The first letter of zidovudine or zalcitabine, often repeated after the drug name as a heading or in a list.

modes.label: Scattered linking words
modes.description: Words like 'prior' or 'after' or 'e.g.,' before a history or exposure term.
modes.example: without a<< prior>> history of psychotic illness or mania can

card.writes: It pushes toward word-start pieces like 'pre', 'contr', 'cas' and away from ball/ault-type endings, with no clear drug link.
card.plain: It lights up on the first letter Z when zidovudine or zalcitabine is being spelled out in HIV drug interaction text.
